I added `apps/react-vite/e2e/tests/discussion-comments.spec.ts`. Nothing has been run, as you asked, so it is untested.

The test follows the smoke test and does this:
1. It goes to `/app/discussions`, creates a discussion and closes the toast.
2. It opens the discussion. Discussions are listed newest first, so it clicks the first "View" link to reach the one it just created.
3. It adds two comments with `createComment()` and closes each "Comment Created" toast.
4. It checks the comments list has two items.
5. It deletes the first comment by finding the list item with that comment's text and clicking its "Delete Comment" button. It then confirms in the dialog and closes the "Comment Deleted" toast.
6. It checks the list has one item left, the deleted body is hidden and the other body is visible.

I did not copy the smoke test's cleanup, so the discussion stays in the test team afterwards.

I did not check that the confirmation dialog has the `dialog` role. If it doesn't, the dialog button locator will fail.
